name: Sweet orange (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Sweet orange (Citrus sinensis) [Fruits] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 169097 (SR Legacy 09200) - Oranges, raw, all commercial varieties
Frontiers in Nutrition / PMC9858198 (2023) - Juices and By-Products of Red-Fleshed Sweet Oranges: sugars and organic acids by HPLC in Navel, Cara Cara, Kirkwood juice
HPLC organic-acid literature for orange juice (citric > quinic > malic > succinic)
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources: sucrose > fructose ~ glucose (total ~9.3 g/100g) plus a large organic-acid pool dominated by citric acid (~1.5 g/100g) with quinic, malic and succinic acids - the organic acids were the main gap in the FooDB record and are a major fermentable carbon source. Nitrogen is thin (0.94 g protein/100g) with free asparagine, proline and arginine dominating the free-amino pool. Organic-acid amounts are taken from fresh/juice HPLC (edible orange is ~85% juice) and expressed
curation_added: citric acid (1.48 g/100g) - dominant organic acid, absent from FooDB record
quinic acid (0.74 g/100g) - absent from record
succinic acid (0.27 g/100g) - absent from record
malic acid quantified (0.42 g/100g; was unquantified L-Malate)
individual sugars quantified: sucrose 4.28, glucose 2.24, fructose 2.53 g/100g
full amino-acid amounts incl. L-valine (was missing) and asparagine flag

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
